name: [🎃] Don't wake the brainrot Tower🖐
desc:
Shh… 🤫 They are sleeping on the tower !

📡 Place brainrots and unlock stronger ones as you play !
😈 Use your remote to wake them and knock players off !
🧗‍♂️ Climb higher while dodging chaos and slaps !
🎮 Outsmart rivals with clever traps and evil timing !

❤️ Like & Favorite the game for more chaos and updates !
